en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong...ding dong...*

<CLT=cltMIND>The doorbell?
Is it Kaito or Maki looking for me?
<CLT=cltMIND>Who could be here at this hour?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
Hey there, Poo-ichi!
No? What about Goo-ichi? Spoo-ichi?
Well, whatever! Pick any nickname you want!
M-Miu? What are you doing here?

I figured me and the twins could swing by and
pay your virgin ass a visit! Got a boner yet!?
...What are you doing here?
What am I doing here?

Ch-Cheer up! Thanks to me, you get to
leave this confining place!
We can escape?

Just come to the computer room on the
4th floor of the academy!

But there's no rush, so if you wanna rub one
out while you think about me, you got time.

Hah-hahaha! But you better bring the
crusty tissues afterward!

<CLT=cltMIND>Despite what she's saying, she doesn't
sound all that serious...
<CLT=cltMIND>But I shouldn't just ignore her.
The computer room on the 4th floor...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bed is starting to feel more comfortable,
I just might prefer it over futons...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>So many identical uniforms
in my closet...

<CLT=cltMIND>That kind of preparation must mean
that they were targeting us.
